# bash completion for jet (generated by `jet self completions bash`)
_jet() {
local cur prev cmds flags
COMPREPLY=()
cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
cmds="registry inspect self diff merge run check test build dev serve debug repl new fmt fix lint explain env push trust bridge services image os add remove update init store config outdated search info logs clean emit eval bench fuzz version help"
flags="--json --color --version --emit-rust --check --diff --changed --stdin-path --small --locked --annotated --force --message --before --spdx --cyclonedx --advisory-db --vendor-dir --sbom --verbose --online --fix --dry-run --try-anyway --restart --swap --watch --project --pure --freestanding --allow-impure --allow-exec --allow-fs --allow-net --allow-env --allow-io --allow-db --allow-time --allow-rand --allow-log --allow-gpu --target --explain-partition --capabilities-json --update-snapshots --coverage --rust -u --release --profile --a11y --scope --filter --shuffle --serial --iterations --time --seed --corpus"
if [[ "$cur" == -* ]]; then
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$flags" -- "$cur") )
return 0
fi
if [[ $COMP_CWORD -eq 1 ]]; then
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "$cmds" -- "$cur") )
return 0
fi
if [[ $COMP_CWORD -eq 2 ]]; then
case "${COMP_WORDS[1]}" in
        registry) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "publish yank keygen key vendor" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        inspect) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "graph query explain-build impact dossier semindex expand schema codemod audit sbom bind" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        store) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "verify rollback generations gc fetch lock" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        self) COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "toolchain upgrade doctor completions man devtools lsp" -- "$cur") ); return 0 ;;
        esac
fi
COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -f -- "$cur") )
}
complete -F _jet jet
